findings:
Intake reference: FULFILLMENT-6dd30b971e
FINDING: billing.py total includes inactive lines, e.g. active 10.00 + inactive 10.00 with rate 0 returns 20.00 should return 10.00
FINDING: reservations.py reserve rejects exact stock, e.g. stock {"A":5}, reserve(stock,"A",5) returns False should return True
FINDING: dispatch.py ready excludes due exactly now, e.g. ready([{"id":"a","status":"queued","due":10}], 10) returns [] should return ["a"]
FINDING: allocations.py available subtracts other warehouses, e.g. stock {(1,"A"):10}, pending [{"sku":"A","warehouse":2,"qty":10}] for warehouse 1 returns 0 should return 10
FINDING: refunds.py refundable deducts pending instead of settled, e.g. captured 100 with settled 30 + pending 10 returns 90 should return 70
FINDING: paging.py page drops same-sequence ids after cursor, e.g. rows [(1,"a"),(1,"b")], after=(1,"a") returns [] should return [(1,"b")]
FINDING: retries.py next_delay doubles first retry, e.g. next_delay(1) with base=2 returns 4 should return 2
FINDING: export.py snapshot keeps last input not max sequence, e.g. [{"sku":"A","sequence":2},{"sku":"A","sequence":1}] keeps sequence 1 should keep sequence 2
VERDICT: REVISE
